meta.name: yahoo-finance
meta.description: Use for fetching real-time and historical stock prices, crypto prices, market data, and financial information from Yahoo Finance. Supports Korean stocks (KRX), US stocks, and global markets including cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询股票、加密货币等实时和历史行情
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要获取股票、加密货币等金融市场的实时数据。
copy.tagline_en: Fetch real-time and historical stock and crypto prices.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need real-time financial market data for stocks and cryptocurrencies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以获取股票、加密货币的实时和历史价格、市场数据、公司财务信息、期权链、股票筛选结果和分析师建议。
howto.when: 当你询问股票价格、加密货币价值、公司财务信息、投资研究、历史价格数据、分析师建议或股票筛选时触发。

say.note: Claude 会返回苹果的实时股价。

say.text: 比特币的历史价格走势如何？
say.note: Claude 会获取比特币的历史价格数据。

say.text: 三星电子的市盈率是多少？
say.note: Claude 会查询三星电子的财务数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch real-time and historical prices for stocks and cryptocurrencies, market data, company financials, option chains, stock screening results, and analyst recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about stock prices, cryptocurrency values, company financials, investment research, historical price data, analyst recommendations, or stock screening.

say_en.text: What is Apple's stock price now?
say_en.note: Claude will return Apple's real-time stock price.

say_en.text: Show me Bitcoin's historical price trend.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch Bitcoin's historical price data.

say_en.text: What is Samsung Electronics' P/E ratio?
say_en.note: Claude will query Samsung Electronics' financial data.
